==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

[[Hanselle Renshar]] is meeting with Elayne to request safe conduct for the other Lords and Ladies of High Houses in Andor. Elayne does not know their motives and fears they may assault the city or demand she surrender. Finally she writes out the safe conduct for [[Luan Norwelyn]], [[Arathelle Renshar]], [[Pelivar Coelan]], [[Aemlyn Carand]], [[Ellorien Traemane]] and [[Abelle Pendar]] appending that they must speak of the [[Borderlands|Borderlanders]] which have an army of two hundred thousand not too far from the city. Elayne knows the Borderlanders' plan but is using their presence to try to secure her throne. [[Dyelin]] affirms that she does not want the throne and is confident that Elayne will be one of the best queens Andor has had.

[[Melfane Dawlish]] the midwife examines Elayne and finds no problems. Elayne dislikes the regular examinations but is happy that her diet has been changed from bland food to a more regular diet. Elayne meets with the nobles in the Grand Hall of the palace. After some insults from Ellorien they request a truce so they can deal with the Borderlanders. Elayne questions the need for a truce since they are not at war and no one else has declared for the throne. They amend the request to be for a temporary agreement. Elayne informs them the Borderlanders are looking for [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and are camped nearby due to the condition of the roads. Ellorien expresses outrage since Elayne is still not crowned as Queen, but Elayne shuts her down saying she made her decision based on being [[Aes Sedai]], not Queen of Andor. Elayne has made an agreement with the Borderlanders and asks the nobles what they would have done differently.

Talk shifts to the [[Black Tower]]. Elayne says she can do nothing about the Black Tower, any more than she could do something if the White Tower somehow appeared in Andor. Abelle and Luan then announce their support for Elayne followed by the others except Ellorien, which gives Elayne enough support to be crowned queen. As everyone retires from the Grand Hall, Elayne wonders how long until [[Tarmon Gai'don]]?
